description: Plan pomodoro sessions: a work and break schedule for a total amount of study time, with a long break after a set number of sessions. Give start_time, like 09:00, to get clock times for each block. Example prompt: "Plan 3 hours of studying as pomodoro blocks with breaks."

sessions_before_long_break.description: Work sessions before a long break.

start_time.description: Clock time the first block starts, like 09:00. Leave it out to list the blocks as minutes from the start.

name: pomodoro_plan
title: Pomodoro plan
